knowledge: A player's attribute scores (overall_rating, potential, finishing, curve, volleys, dribbling, ball_control, crossing, long_shots, heading_accuracy, sprint_speed, strength, aggression, short_passing, ...) are 0-100 scores calculated by FIFA, and a player has many dated records: a question about 'his <score>' first locates the record(s) in the window it names, then reads or aggregates them.

Team tactical scores are recorded per dated record as well (build-up play speed / passing, chance creation passing / crossing / shooting, defence pressure / aggression / team width). Each score has a companion class: speed class = Slow (1-33) / Balanced (34-66) / Fast (66-100); passing class = Short (1-33) / Mixed (34-66) / Long (66-100); chance creation passing class = Safe (1-33) / Normal (34-66) / Risky (66-100); defence aggression class = Contain (1-33) / Press (34-66) / Double (66-100). 'The speed in which attacks are put together' is the build-up play speed.
Preferred foot takes the values right / left when attacking.

Work rates: attacking work rate -- high: the player is going to be in all of your attack moves; medium: the player selects the attack actions he will join in; low: remain in his position while the team attacks. Defensive work rate -- high: remain in his position and defense while the team attacks; medium; low: the player is going to be in all of your attack moves instead of defensing.

The birthday is a date value: player A is older than player B when A's birthday is earlier than B's, so a later birthday means a younger player. 'Age at present' is the current year minus the birth year.

A match records the home team and the away team with their goals ('the goal of the home team' / 'the goal of the away team'); a team won when its goals exceed the opponent's, and a match ended as a draw when the two are equal.

The season of a match is a spanning label such as 2015/2016 (a question's '2016 season' is that label). The date of the match is stored as e.g. 2008-08-17 00:00:00; a year window filters on the year, a month on the year-month, a day on the date.
